from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any
from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.enums import TaskAgentType
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext

from .task import BaseTaskConfiguration


class BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """TaskAgent responsible for resolving a node"""

    name: str = Field(description="The name of the agent")
    description: str = Field(description="A description of what the agent does")
    agent_instructions: str = Field(
        description="Instructions for how the agent should behave"
    )

    task_instruction_transformer: (
        Callable[[str | None, BaseTaskConfiguration, OrchestratorTaskAgentContext], str]
        | None
    ) = Field(
        default=None, description="Transformer for task instructions (if provided)"
    )

    def merge_config(self, agent_config: Self) -> Self:
        """Merge another agent configuration to this configuration. Will not merge callable fields"""
        original_data = self.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        node_data = agent_config.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        merged_data = {**original_data, **node_data}

        return self.__class__(**merged_data)


class GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for greeting the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        description="The type of agent for greeting users",
    )


class DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for data collecting from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        description="The type of agent for data collecting from users",
    )


class InformationTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for gathering information from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        description="The type of agent for gathering information from users",
    )
    job_details: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Details about the job"
    )


class CloserTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for closing the call/deal"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        description="The type of agent for closing calls or deals",
    )


class QATaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for answering candidate's questions"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.QA,
        description="The type of agent for answering candidate's questions",
    )


class ConfirmationTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for getting candidate confirmation"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CONFIRMATION,
        description="The type of agent for getting candidate confirmation",
    )


TaskAgentConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration
    | DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
    | InformationTaskAgentConfiguration
    | CloserTaskAgentConfiguration
    | ConfirmationTaskAgentConfiguration
    | QATaskAgentConfiguration
)

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.enums import TaskAgentType
from commons.enums import TaskFailureBehavior
from commons.enums import TaskValidationType


class TaskSuccessStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling successful completion of a task."""

    description: str = Field(
        description="Description of what constitutes success for this task"
    )


class TaskFailureStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling failed completion of a task."""

    failure_reason: str = Field(description="Reason why this task failed")


class TaskFailureRetryStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling retry of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY, description="Behavior to retry the agent"
    )
    max_attempts: int = Field(description="Maximum number of retry attempts allowed")


class TaskFailureSkipStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling skipping of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP, description="Behavior to skip to next task"
    )
    # proceed with next task if none provided
    next_task_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="ID of the next task to execute after skipping, if none provided proceeds with default next task",
    )


class TaskFailureEndCallStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling call ending of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL, description="Behavior to end the call"
    )


class TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling validation of a task."""

    strategy: Literal[TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY] = Field(
        default=TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY,
        description="Type of validation strategy to use",
    )
    query: str = Field(description="JSONata query string for validating datapoints")
    instructions_on_failure: str = Field(
        description="Instructions for the agent to follow"
    )
    can_end_call: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Whether the call can be ended if the validation fails",
    )


class BaseTaskConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """General Task Configuration"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for this call task")
    title: str = Field(description="Human-readable title for this task")
    initial_message: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional initial message to send when entering this task",
    )
    task_instructions: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional specific instructions for the agent processing this task",
    )
    is_adhoc_task: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Whether this task only exists within a conditional path",
    )

    # # Configuration for handling successful completion of a task.
    # # If none provided, this is a terminal task.
    # on_success: TaskSuccessStrategy | None = Field(
    #     default=None,
    #     description="Configuration for handling successful completion of a task. If none provided, this is a terminal task",
    # )

    # # Configuration for handling failed completion of a task.
    # # If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping
    # failure_handling: list[TaskFailureEndCallStrategy | TaskFailureRetryStrategy | TaskFailureSkipStrategy] = Field(
    #     default=[],
    #     description="Configuration for handling failed completion of a task. If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping",
    # )

    # # Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task.
    # # All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task
    # # pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile
    # pre_requisites: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
    #     default=[],
    #     description="Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task. All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task. Pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile",
    # )


class GreeterTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Greeter Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.GREETING] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this greeting task",
    )


class InformationTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Information Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.INFORMATION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this information task",
    )


class CloserTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Closer Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.CLOSER] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this closer task",
    )


class QATaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a QA Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.QA] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.QA,
        description="Type of agent that will handle answering question from agent",
    )


class ConfirmationTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Confirmation Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.CONFIRMATION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CONFIRMATION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle confirmation from agent",
    )
    adhoc_task_ids_on_unsuccessful: list[str] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="List of tasks to do when the confirmation is unsuccessful",
    )


class DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Data Collection Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this data collection task",
    )

    candidate_data_points_to_collect: list[str] = Field(
        description="List of datapoints to collect from the candidate",
    )

    # Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task.
    # All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task
    # post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task
    validations: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task. All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task. Post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task",
    )


TaskConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskConfiguration
    | InformationTaskConfiguration
    | DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
    | CloserTaskConfiguration
    | ConfirmationTaskConfiguration
    | QATaskConfiguration
)

from collections.abc import Awaitable
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from livekit.agents import ChatContext
from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import ConfigDict
from pydantic import Field

from commons.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
from commons.schemas.call_script import JobContext
from commons.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition
from commons.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration


class TaskAgentInterruptRequest(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Feedback from an agent as it is processing a task"""

    type: TaskAgentInterruptType = Field(description="Type of the interruption")
    interrupt_note: str = Field(
        description="Interruption note to allow orchestrator to handle"
    )


class OrchestratorFailedTask(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living state of a task in the orchestrator"""

    id: str = Field(description="ID of the task")
    reason: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Reason for the task state (if any)"
    )


class SessionDataState(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living State of a Voice Agent, contains collected data from user and only modifiable by the agent"""

    current_node_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="The current node id of the call script"
    )

    candidate_datapoints: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate during the call",
    )

    confirmation: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any confirmation collected for the candidate during the call",
    )

    current_agent_interruption: TaskAgentInterruptRequest | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Current interruption (if any) from the agent"
    )
    # candidate_signals: dict[str, Any] = Field(
    #     default_factory=dict, description="Any signal collected for the candidate during the call"
    # )
    # notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Any notes collected for the candidate during the call")


class TaskAgentHooks(BaseModel):
    """Hooks to allow agent to interact with call orchestrator"""

    on_task_agent_interrupt: Callable[[TaskAgentInterruptRequest], Awaitable[None]] = (
        Field(description="Callback when agent needs help to move forward")
    )
    on_task_agent_finished: Callable[[BaseTaskConfiguration, str], Awaitable[None]] = (
        Field(description="Callback when agent has finished all its task")
    )
    on_datapoint_collected: Callable[[str, dict[str, Any]], Awaitable[None]] = Field(
        description="Callback when agent has collected a datapoint"
    )
    on_end_call: Callable[[str], Awaitable[None]] = Field(
        description="Callback when agent has decided to ended the call"
    )
    on_add_adhoc_tasks: Callable[[list[str]], Awaitable[None]] = Field(
        description="Callback when agent has decided to add adhoc tasks"
    )


class OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(BaseModel):
    """
    Context from the orchestrator passing in to each task agent
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)

    task_agent_hooks: TaskAgentHooks = Field(
        description="Hooks to allow agent to interact with call orchestrator"
    )
    chat_ctx: ChatContext | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Chat context for the agent if previous history exist"
    )
    job_details: JobContext
    candidate_data_point_schemas: dict[str, CandidateDatapointDefinition]
    in_progress_task_ids: list[str]
    outstanding_task_ids: list[str]
    completed_task_ids: list[str]

from typing import Annotated
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition

from .task import TaskConfiguration


class JobContext(BaseModel):
    """Context about the job position being discussed."""

    title: str = Field(description="Title of the job position")
    description: str = Field(description="Detailed description of the job position")
    company: str = Field(description="Company offering the job position")
    location: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Location of the job position"
    )
    contract_type: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Type of contract (W2, 1099, etc)"
    )
    start_date: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Expected start date for the job position"
    )
    schedule: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Schedule information for the job position"
    )


class CallScriptContext(BaseModel):
    """Context for Call Script"""

    job: JobContext = Field(description="the job position being discussed.")
    candidate: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate prior to the call",
    )
    knowledge_base: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Knowledge base for the job position"
    )


class CallScript(BaseModel):
    """Script for an AI faciliated call with candidates. This object will be immutable"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for the call script")

    candidate_data_point_schemas: dict[str, CandidateDatapointDefinition] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="dictionary of all candidate datapoint schemas referenced in the call script",
    )
    context: CallScriptContext = Field(description="Context for the call script")

    tasks: list[
        Annotated[TaskConfiguration, Field(discriminator="task_agent_type")]
    ] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of call node configurations")

"""
Pydantic models for Purplefish API
"""

from typing import Any
from typing import Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel


class CreateEngagementRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request model for creating an engagement"""

    room_name: str
    opportunity_id: Optional[str] = None
    candidate_phone_number: Optional[str] = None
    agent_phone_number: Optional[str] = None


class AgentPhoneNumber(BaseModel):
    """Agent phone number details"""

    id: str
    number: str
    sip_outbound_trunk_id: str
    sip_outbound_trunk_for_inbound_id: str


class CreateEngagementResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response model for creating an engagement"""

    id: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    profile_id: str
    room_name: str
    agent_phone_number: Optional[AgentPhoneNumber] = None
    is_newly_created: bool
    agent_name: Optional[str] = None

    # Alias for backward compatibility
    @property
    def engagement_id(self) -> str:
        """Alias for id to maintain backward compatibility"""
        return self.id


class CandidateDataPointRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request model for posting candidate data points"""

    candidate_data_point_schema_id: str
    value: Any


class MessageRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request model for posting messages"""

    content: str
    role: str
    task_id: str
    interrupted: bool
    occurred_at: str
    relative_timestamp: str

import os
from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field
from pydantic import SecretStr

from commons.monitoring import logging


logger = logging.get_logger(__name__)


class SecretConfig(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for API keys and secrets that should not be logged"""

    cartesia_api_key: SecretStr = Field(description="Cartesia API key")
    deepgram_api_key: SecretStr = Field(description="Deepgram API key")
    openai_api_key: SecretStr = Field(description="OpenAI API key")
    livekit_api_key: SecretStr = Field(
        default=SecretStr("devkey"), description="LiveKit API key"
    )
    livekit_api_secret: SecretStr = Field(
        default=SecretStr("secret"), description="LiveKit API secret"
    )
    r2_endpoint: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 endpoint URL")
    r2_key: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 access key")
    r2_secret: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 secret key")
    dd_api_key: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="DataDog API key")
    agent_auth_token_secret: SecretStr = Field(
        default=SecretStr(""), description="Secret for generating agent auth tokens"
    )

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> Self:
        from dotenv import load_dotenv

        load_dotenv()

        # Get all environment variables and check for empty values
        cartesia_api_key = os.getenv("CARTESIA_API_KEY", "")
        deepgram_api_key = os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY", "")
        openai_api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
        r2_endpoint = os.getenv("R2_ENDPOINT", "")
        r2_key = os.getenv("R2_KEY", "")
        r2_secret = os.getenv("R2_SECRET", "")
        livekit_api_key = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_KEY_INBOUND", "devkey")
        livekit_api_secret = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_INBOUND", "secret")
        dd_api_key = os.getenv("DD_API_KEY", "")
        agent_auth_token_secret = os.getenv("AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET", "")

        # Check for empty fields and raise error
        empty_fields = []
        if not cartesia_api_key:
            empty_fields.append("CARTESIA_API_KEY")
        if not deepgram_api_key:
            empty_fields.append("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
        if not openai_api_key:
            empty_fields.append("OPENAI_API_KEY")

        if empty_fields:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing required environment variables: {', '.join(empty_fields)}"
            )

        return cls(
            cartesia_api_key=SecretStr(cartesia_api_key),
            deepgram_api_key=SecretStr(deepgram_api_key),
            openai_api_key=SecretStr(openai_api_key),
            r2_endpoint=SecretStr(r2_endpoint),
            r2_key=SecretStr(r2_key),
            r2_secret=SecretStr(r2_secret),
            dd_api_key=SecretStr(dd_api_key),
            livekit_api_key=SecretStr(livekit_api_key),
            livekit_api_secret=SecretStr(livekit_api_secret),
            agent_auth_token_secret=SecretStr(agent_auth_token_secret),
        )


class EnvironmentConfig(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for all environment variables"""

    # Non-secret environment variables
    agent_env: str = Field(default="development", description="Agent environment")
    livekit_url: str = Field(
        default="ws://127.0.0.1:7880", description="LiveKit WebSocket URL"
    )
    cartesia_model: str = Field(default="sonic-2", description="Cartesia model")
    cartesia_default_voice: str = Field(
        default="f786b574-daa5-4673-aa0c-cbe3e8534c02",
        description="Default Cartesia voice ID",
    )
    deepgram_model: str = Field(default="nova-3", description="Deepgram model")
    deepgram_language: str = Field(
        default="multi", description="Deepgram language setting"
    )
    voice_openai_model: str = Field(
        default="gpt-4.1-mini", description="OpenAI model for voice processing"
    )
    log_level: str = Field(default="DEBUG", description="Logging level")
    worker_drain_timeout: int = Field(
        default=0, description="Worker drain timeout in seconds"
    )
    composite_recording: bool = Field(
        default=False, description="Enable composite recording"
    )
    jobs_api_host: str = Field(
        default="http://localhost:3000", description="Purplefish Jobs API host URL"
    )

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any
from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.enums import TaskAgentType
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext

from .task import BaseTaskConfiguration


class BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """TaskAgent responsible for resolving a node"""

    name: str = Field(description="The name of the agent")
    description: str = Field(description="A description of what the agent does")
    agent_instructions: str = Field(
        description="Instructions for how the agent should behave"
    )

    task_instruction_transformer: (
        Callable[[str | None, BaseTaskConfiguration, OrchestratorTaskAgentContext], str]
        | None
    ) = Field(
        default=None, description="Transformer for task instructions (if provided)"
    )

    def merge_config(self, agent_config: Self) -> Self:
        """Merge another agent configuration to this configuration. Will not merge callable fields"""
        original_data = self.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        node_data = agent_config.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        merged_data = {**original_data, **node_data}

        return self.__class__(**merged_data)


class GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for greeting the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        description="The type of agent for greeting users",
    )


class DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for data collecting from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        description="The type of agent for data collecting from users",
    )


class InformationTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for gathering information from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        description="The type of agent for gathering information from users",
    )
    job_details: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Details about the job"
    )


class CloserTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for closing the call/deal"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        description="The type of agent for closing calls or deals",
    )


class QATaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for answering candidate's questions"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.QA,
        description="The type of agent for answering candidate's questions",
    )


class ConfirmationTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for getting candidate confirmation"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CONFIRMATION,
        description="The type of agent for getting candidate confirmation",
    )


TaskAgentConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration
    | DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
    | InformationTaskAgentConfiguration
    | CloserTaskAgentConfiguration
    | ConfirmationTaskAgentConfiguration
    | QATaskAgentConfiguration
)

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.enums import TaskAgentType
from commons.enums import TaskFailureBehavior
from commons.enums import TaskValidationType


class TaskSuccessStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling successful completion of a task."""

    description: str = Field(
        description="Description of what constitutes success for this task"
    )


class TaskFailureStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling failed completion of a task."""

    failure_reason: str = Field(description="Reason why this task failed")


class TaskFailureRetryStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling retry of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.RETRY, description="Behavior to retry the agent"
    )
    max_attempts: int = Field(description="Maximum number of retry attempts allowed")


class TaskFailureSkipStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling skipping of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.SKIP, description="Behavior to skip to next task"
    )
    # proceed with next task if none provided
    next_task_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="ID of the next task to execute after skipping, if none provided proceeds with default next task",
    )


class TaskFailureEndCallStrategy(TaskFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling call ending of a task."""

    behavior: Literal[TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL] = Field(
        default=TaskFailureBehavior.END_CALL, description="Behavior to end the call"
    )


class TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling validation of a task."""

    strategy: Literal[TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY] = Field(
        default=TaskValidationType.CANDIDATE_DATA_POINT_QUERY,
        description="Type of validation strategy to use",
    )
    query: str = Field(description="JSONata query string for validating datapoints")
    instructions_on_failure: str = Field(
        description="Instructions for the agent to follow"
    )
    can_end_call: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Whether the call can be ended if the validation fails",
    )


class BaseTaskConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """General Task Configuration"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for this call task")
    title: str = Field(description="Human-readable title for this task")
    initial_message: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional initial message to send when entering this task",
    )
    task_instructions: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional specific instructions for the agent processing this task",
    )
    is_adhoc_task: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Whether this task only exists within a conditional path",
    )

    # # Configuration for handling successful completion of a task.
    # # If none provided, this is a terminal task.
    # on_success: TaskSuccessStrategy | None = Field(
    #     default=None,
    #     description="Configuration for handling successful completion of a task. If none provided, this is a terminal task",
    # )

    # # Configuration for handling failed completion of a task.
    # # If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping
    # failure_handling: list[TaskFailureEndCallStrategy | TaskFailureRetryStrategy | TaskFailureSkipStrategy] = Field(
    #     default=[],
    #     description="Configuration for handling failed completion of a task. If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping",
    # )

    # # Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task.
    # # All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task
    # # pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile
    # pre_requisites: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
    #     default=[],
    #     description="Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a task. All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this task. Pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile",
    # )


class GreeterTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Greeter Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.GREETING] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this greeting task",
    )


class InformationTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Information Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.INFORMATION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this information task",
    )


class CloserTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Closer Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.CLOSER] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this closer task",
    )


class QATaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a QA Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.QA] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.QA,
        description="Type of agent that will handle answering question from agent",
    )


class ConfirmationTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Confirmation Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.CONFIRMATION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.CONFIRMATION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle confirmation from agent",
    )
    adhoc_task_ids_on_unsuccessful: list[str] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="List of tasks to do when the confirmation is unsuccessful",
    )


class DataCollectionTaskConfiguration(BaseTaskConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Data Collection Task"""

    task_agent_type: Literal[TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION] = Field(
        default=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        description="Type of agent that will handle this data collection task",
    )

    candidate_data_points_to_collect: list[str] = Field(
        description="List of datapoints to collect from the candidate",
    )

    # Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task.
    # All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task
    # post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task
    validations: list[TaskDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling post-requisites of a task. All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed task. Post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this task",
    )


TaskConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskConfiguration
    | InformationTaskConfiguration
    | DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
    | CloserTaskConfiguration
    | ConfirmationTaskConfiguration
    | QATaskConfiguration
)

from collections.abc import Awaitable
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from livekit.agents import ChatContext
from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import ConfigDict
from pydantic import Field

from commons.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
from commons.schemas.call_script import JobContext
from commons.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition
from commons.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration


class TaskAgentInterruptRequest(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Feedback from an agent as it is processing a task"""

    type: TaskAgentInterruptType = Field(description="Type of the interruption")
    interrupt_note: str = Field(
        description="Interruption note to allow orchestrator to handle"
    )


class OrchestratorFailedTask(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living state of a task in the orchestrator"""

    id: str = Field(description="ID of the task")
    reason: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Reason for the task state (if any)"
    )


class SessionDataState(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living State of a Voice Agent, contains collected data from user and only modifiable by the agent"""

    current_node_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="The current node id of the call script"
    )

    candidate_datapoints: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate during the call",
    )

    confirmation: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any confirmation collected for the candidate during the call",
    )

    current_agent_interruption: TaskAgentInterruptRequest | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Current interruption (if any) from the agent"
    )
    # candidate_signals: dict[str, Any] = Field(
    #     default_factory=dict, description="Any signal collected for the candidate during the call"
    # )
    # notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Any notes collected for the candidate during the call")


class TaskAgentHooks(BaseModel):
    """Hooks to allow agent to interact with call orchestrator"""

    on_task_agent_interrupt: Callable[[TaskAgentInterruptRequest], Awaitable[None]] = (
        Field(description="Callback when agent needs help to move forward")
    )
    on_task_agent_finished: Callable[[BaseTaskConfiguration, str], Awaitable[None]] = (
        Field(description="Callback when agent has finished all its task")
    )
    on_datapoint_collected: Callable[[str, dict[str, Any]], Awaitable[None]] = Field(
        description="Callback when agent has collected a datapoint"
    )
    on_end_call: Callable[[str], Awaitable[None]] = Field(
        description="Callback when agent has decided to ended the call"
    )
    on_add_adhoc_tasks: Callable[[list[str]], Awaitable[None]] = Field(
        description="Callback when agent has decided to add adhoc tasks"
    )


class OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(BaseModel):
    """
    Context from the orchestrator passing in to each task agent
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)

    task_agent_hooks: TaskAgentHooks = Field(
        description="Hooks to allow agent to interact with call orchestrator"

    in_progress_task_ids: list[str]

    completed_task_ids: list[str]

from typing import Annotated
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.schemas.candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition

from .task import TaskConfiguration


class JobContext(BaseModel):
    """Context about the job position being discussed."""

    title: str = Field(description="Title of the job position")
    description: str = Field(description="Detailed description of the job position")
    company: str = Field(description="Company offering the job position")
    location: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Location of the job position"
    )
    contract_type: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Type of contract (W2, 1099, etc)"
    )
    start_date: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Expected start date for the job position"
    )
    schedule: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Schedule information for the job position"
    )


class CallScriptContext(BaseModel):
    """Context for Call Script"""

    job: JobContext = Field(description="the job position being discussed.")
    candidate: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate prior to the call",
    )
    knowledge_base: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Knowledge base for the job position"
    )


class CallScript(BaseModel):
    """Script for an AI faciliated call with candidates. This object will be immutable"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for the call script")

    candidate_data_point_schemas: dict[str, CandidateDatapointDefinition] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="dictionary of all candidate datapoint schemas referenced in the call script",
    )
    context: CallScriptContext = Field(description="Context for the call script")

    tasks: list[
        Annotated[TaskConfiguration, Field(discriminator="task_agent_type")]
    ] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of call node configurations")

from pydantic import BaseModel


class CreateEngagementRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request model for creating an engagement"""

    room_name: str
    opportunity_id: Optional[str] = None
    candidate_phone_number: Optional[str] = None
    agent_phone_number: Optional[str] = None

class CreateEngagementResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response model for creating an engagement"""

    id: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    profile_id: str
    room_name: str
    agent_phone_number: Optional[AgentPhoneNumber] = None
    is_newly_created: bool
    agent_name: Optional[str] = None

    # Alias for backward compatibility
    @property
    def engagement_id(self) -> str:
        """Alias for id to maintain backward compatibility"""
        return self.id

    """Request model for posting candidate data points"""

    candidate_data_point_schema_id: str
    value: Any

    """Request model for posting messages"""

import os
from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field
from pydantic import SecretStr

from commons.monitoring import logging


logger = logging.get_logger(__name__)


class SecretConfig(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for API keys and secrets that should not be logged"""

    cartesia_api_key: SecretStr = Field(description="Cartesia API key")
    deepgram_api_key: SecretStr = Field(description="Deepgram API key")
    openai_api_key: SecretStr = Field(description="OpenAI API key")
    livekit_api_key: SecretStr = Field(
        default=SecretStr("devkey"), description="LiveKit API key"
    )
    livekit_api_secret: SecretStr = Field(
        default=SecretStr("secret"), description="LiveKit API secret"
    )
    r2_endpoint: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 endpoint URL")
    r2_key: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 access key")
    r2_secret: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 secret key")
    dd_api_key: SecretStr = Field(default=SecretStr(""), description="DataDog API key")
    agent_auth_token_secret: SecretStr = Field(
        default=SecretStr(""), description="Secret for generating agent auth tokens"
    )

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> Self:
        from dotenv import load_dotenv

        load_dotenv()

        # Get all environment variables and check for empty values
        cartesia_api_key = os.getenv("CARTESIA_API_KEY", "")
        deepgram_api_key = os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY", "")
        openai_api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
        r2_endpoint = os.getenv("R2_ENDPOINT", "")
        r2_key = os.getenv("R2_KEY", "")
        r2_secret = os.getenv("R2_SECRET", "")
        livekit_api_key = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_KEY_INBOUND", "devkey")
        livekit_api_secret = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_INBOUND", "secret")
        dd_api_key = os.getenv("DD_API_KEY", "")
        agent_auth_token_secret = os.getenv("AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET", "")

        # Check for empty fields and raise error
        empty_fields = []
        if not cartesia_api_key:
            empty_fields.append("CARTESIA_API_KEY")
        if not deepgram_api_key:
            empty_fields.append("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
        if not openai_api_key:
            empty_fields.append("OPENAI_API_KEY")

        if empty_fields:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing required environment variables: {', '.join(empty_fields)}"
            )

        return cls(
            cartesia_api_key=SecretStr(cartesia_api_key),
            deepgram_api_key=SecretStr(deepgram_api_key),
            openai_api_key=SecretStr(openai_api_key),
            r2_endpoint=SecretStr(r2_endpoint),
            r2_key=SecretStr(r2_key),
            r2_secret=SecretStr(r2_secret),
            dd_api_key=SecretStr(dd_api_key),
            livekit_api_key=SecretStr(livekit_api_key),
            livekit_api_secret=SecretStr(livekit_api_secret),
            agent_auth_token_secret=SecretStr(agent_auth_token_secret),
        )


class EnvironmentConfig(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for all environment variables"""

    # Non-secret environment variables
    agent_env: str = Field(default="development", description="Agent environment")
    livekit_url: str = Field(
        default="ws://127.0.0.1:7880", description="LiveKit WebSocket URL"
    )
    cartesia_model: str = Field(default="sonic-2", description="Cartesia model")
    cartesia_default_voice: str = Field(
        default="f786b574-daa5-4673-aa0c-cbe3e8534c02",
        description="Default Cartesia voice ID",
    )
    deepgram_model: str = Field(default="nova-3", description="Deepgram model")
    deepgram_language: str = Field(
        default="multi", description="Deepgram language setting"
    )
    voice_openai_model: str = Field(
        default="gpt-4.1-mini", description="OpenAI model for voice processing"
    )
    log_level: str = Field(default="DEBUG", description="Logging level")
    worker_drain_timeout: int = Field(
        default=0, description="Worker drain timeout in seconds"
    )
    composite_recording: bool = Field(
        default=False, description="Enable composite recording"
    )
    jobs_api_host: str = Field(
        default="http://localhost:3000", description="Purplefish Jobs API host URL"
    )

    # Secret configuration
    secrets: SecretConfig = Field(description="Secret configuration")

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> Self:
        from dotenv import load_dotenv

        load_dotenv()
        agent_env = os.getenv("AGENT_ENV", "development")
        """Create configuration from environment variables"""

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any
from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic import Field

from commons.enums import TaskAgentType
from commons.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext

from .task import BaseTaskConfiguration


class BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """TaskAgent responsible for resolving a node"""

    name: str = Field(alias="name", description="The name of the agent")
    description: str = Field(alias="description", description="A description of what the agent does")
    agent_instructions: str = Field(
        alias="agentInstructions",
        description="Instructions for how the agent should behave"
    )

    task_instruction_transformer: (
        Callable[[str | None, BaseTaskConfiguration, OrchestratorTaskAgentContext], str]
        | None
    ) = Field(
        alias="taskInstructionTransformer",
        default=None, description="Transformer for task instructions (if provided)"
    )

    def merge_config(self, agent_config: Self) -> Self:
        """Merge another agent configuration to this configuration. Will not merge callable fields"""
        original_data = self.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        node_data = agent_config.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        merged_data = {**original_data, **node_data}

        return self.__class__(**merged_data)


class GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for greeting the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        alias="agentType",
        default=TaskAgentType.GREETING,
        description="The type of agent for greeting users",
    )


class DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for data collecting from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        alias="agentType",
        default=TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION,
        description="The type of agent for data collecting from users",
    )


class InformationTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for gathering information from the user"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        alias="agentType",
        default=TaskAgentType.INFORMATION,
        description="The type of agent for gathering information from users",
    )
    job_details: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        alias="jobDetails",
        default_factory=dict, description="Details about the job"
    )


class CloserTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for closing the call/deal"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        alias="agentType",
        default=TaskAgentType.CLOSER,
        description="The type of agent for closing calls or deals",
    )


class QATaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for answering candidate's questions"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        alias="agentType",
        default=TaskAgentType.QA,
        description="The type of agent for answering candidate's questions",
    )


class ConfirmationTaskAgentConfiguration(BaseTaskAgentConfiguration):
    """TaskAgent responsible for getting candidate confirmation"""

    agent_type: TaskAgentType = Field(
        alias="agentType",
        default=TaskAgentType.CONFIRMATION,
        description="The type of agent for getting candidate confirmation",
    )


TaskAgentConfiguration = (
    GreeterTaskAgentConfiguration
    | DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
    | InformationTaskAgentConfiguration
    | CloserTaskAgentConfiguration
    | ConfirmationTaskAgentConfiguration
    | QATaskAgentConfiguration
)

        alias="livekitApiSecret",
        default=SecretStr("secret"),
        description="LiveKit API secret",
    )
    r2_endpoint: SecretStr = Field(
        alias="r2Endpoint", default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 endpoint URL"
    )
    r2_key: SecretStr = Field(
        alias="r2Key", default=SecretStr(""), description="R2 access key"
    )
    r2_secret: SecretStr = Field(

    )
    dd_api_key: SecretStr = Field(
        alias="ddApiKey", default=SecretStr(""), description="DataDog API key"
    )
    agent_auth_token_secret: SecretStr = Field(
        alias="agentAuthTokenSecret",
        default=SecretStr(""),
        description="Secret for generating agent auth tokens",
    )

        from dotenv import load_dotenv

        load_dotenv()

        # Get all environment variables and check for empty values

"""
Purplefish API client wrapper for agent operations
"""

from datetime import datetime
from datetime import timezone
from typing import Any
from typing import Dict
from typing import Optional

import httpx
import jwt

from commons.monitoring import logging
from commons.monitoring.tracer import AgentTracer
from commons.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from commons.schemas.purplefish import CreateEngagementResponse


logger = logging.get_logger(__name__)


class PurplefishClient:
    """Wrapper for Purplefish API operations with enhanced logging and tracing"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        auth_token_secret: Optional[str] = None,
        timeout: float = 30.0,
    ):
        """Initialize Purplefish API client

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL for the Purplefish API
            auth_token_secret: Optional secret for generating JWT bearer tokens
            agent_tracer: Optional tracer for monitoring
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds
        """
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.auth_token_secret = auth_token_secret
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.tracer = None  # Initialize tracer to None

        # Configure headers
        self.headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

        # Use JWT bearer token if auth_token_secret is provided
        if self.auth_token_secret:
            bearer_token = self._generate_bearer_token()
            self.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {bearer_token}"

        # Create HTTP client
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers=self.headers,
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(self.timeout),
        )

        logger.debug(
            "PurplefishClient initialized",
            extra={
                "base_url": base_url,
                "auth_method": "jwt" if self.auth_token_secret else "none",
            },
        )

    def configure_tracer(self, tracer_provider: AgentTracer):
        self.tracer = tracer_provider.get_tracer(__name__)

    def _generate_bearer_token(self) -> str:
        """Generate a JWT bearer token using the auth token secret

        Returns:
            JWT token as a string
        """
        if not self.auth_token_secret:
            raise ValueError("auth_token_secret is required to generate bearer token")

        # Following the same pattern as the legacy implementation
        return jwt.encode({}, self.auth_token_secret, algorithm="HS256")

    async def create_engagement(
        self,
        room_name: str,
        opportunity_id: Optional[str] = None,
        candidate_phone_number: Optional[str] = None,
        agent_phone_number: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> CreateEngagementResponse:
        """Create a new engagement

        Args:
            room_name: Name of the LiveKit room
            opportunity_id: Optional opportunity ID
            candidate_phone_number: Optional candidate phone number
            agent_phone_number: Optional agent phone number

        Returns:
            CreateEngagementResponse with agent_name and engagement_id
        """

import json
from datetime import datetime
from datetime import timezone
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import Mock
from unittest.mock import patch

import jwt
import pytest
from pydantic import SecretStr
from pytest_httpserver import HTTPServer

from commons.monitoring.tracer import AgentTracer
from commons.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from commons.schemas.config import EnvironmentConfig
from commons.schemas.config import SecretConfig
from commons.schemas.purplefish import CreateEngagementResponse
from commons.services.purplefish_client import PurplefishClient
from commons.services.purplefish_client import camel_to_snake_case_dict
from routing_agent.router import RoutingAgent


class TestCamelToSnakeCase:
    """Test camelCase to snake_case conversion"""

    def test_simple_conversion(self):
        """Test simple camelCase conversion"""
        data = {
            "firstName": "John",
            "lastName": "Doe",
            "emailAddress": "john@example.com",
        }
        result = camel_to_snake_case_dict(data)
        assert result == {
            "first_name": "John",
            "last_name": "Doe",
            "email_address": "john@example.com",
        }

    def test_nested_dict_conversion(self):
        """Test nested dictionary conversion"""
        data = {
            "userProfile": {

class TestCamelToSnakeCase:
    """Test camelCase to snake_case conversion"""

    def test_simple_conversion(self):
        """Test simple camelCase conversion"""
        data = {
            "firstName": "John",
            "lastName": "Doe",
            "emailAddress": "john@example.com",
        }
        result = camel_to_snake_case_dict(data)
        assert result == {
            "first_name": "John",
            "last_name": "Doe",
            "email_address": "john@example.com",
        }

    def test_nested_dict_conversion(self):
        """Test nested dictionary conversion"""
        data = {
            "userProfile": {
                "userName": "johndoe",
                "accountInfo": {
                    "accountId": "123",
                    "createdDate": "2024-01-01",
                },
            }
        }
        result = camel_to_snake_case_dict(data)
        assert result == {
            "user_profile": {
                "user_name": "johndoe",
                "account_info": {
                    "account_id": "123",
                    "created_date": "2024-01-01",
                },
            }
        }

    def test_list_conversion(self):
        """Test list of dictionaries conversion"""
        data = [
            {"firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe"},
            {"firstName": "Jane", "lastName": "Smith"},
        ]
        result = camel_to_snake_case_dict(data)
        assert result == [
            {"first_name": "John", "last_name": "Doe"},
            {"first_name": "Jane", "last_name": "Smith"},
        ]

    def test_mixed_types(self):
        """Test conversion with mixed types"""
        data = {
            "stringValue": "test",
            "intValue": 42,
            "boolValue": True,
            "nullValue": None,
            "listValue": [1, 2, 3],
        }
        result = camel_to_snake_case_dict(data)
        assert result == {
            "string_value": "test",
            "int_value": 42,
            "bool_value": True,
            "null_value": None,
            "list_value": [1, 2, 3],
        }
